messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the UR5e manual, how long should one wait after switching the robot off before touching it, so that it has time to cool down?

response.text: Secondo il manuale del UR5e, quanto bisogna attendere dopo aver spento il robot prima di toccarlo, in modo che abbia il tempo di raffreddarsi?
